description: Slices the source into elements at USER-SPECIFIED times (no silence detection - works on any material, flat noise verified), cuts random-length segments from element starts, and plays them in random order with optional inserted silences, until dur seconds are filled. Duration is set_by dur with an up-to-one-segment overshoot: the render finishes the segment in flight (verified: dur 4 seed 5 -> 4.0001; dur 2.5 -> 2.854; dur 6 -> 6.257; seed 9 at dur 4 -> 4.238 - overshoot is seed-dependent). SEED WORKS with no clock path (source: unconditional srand(seed)): seed 5 byte-identical 1.2 s apart, 5 vs 9 differ in samples AND duration, seed 0 == seed 1 (glibc), range 0-256. trans (-t) and atten (-a) are BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE at fixed seed (each brk render differs from both scalar endpoints; -t0/-a0 byte-equal flag-less); all six numeric positionals refuse brks. Stereo accepted (2-ch output). Built for speech (banner: elements = words or syllables) but the time-slicing is material-agnostic.
musical_use: Stochastic re-speaking: slice a phrase at its word boundaries (peakfind or by ear) and stutter re-utters it - fragments always start at element STARTS, so attacks and consonants survive and the result babbles convincingly rather than granulating. dur decouples output length from the source: fill 30 s from a 2-second phrase. segjoins > 1 lets cuts span joined element pairs/triples (longer quasi-phrases); silprop/silmin/silmax compose the pausing - speech-like at 0.2-0.4/0.05/0.3, telegraphic at higher silprop; bias pushes toward short fragments (-1, nervous) or whole elements (+1, deliberate). -t adds per-segment random transposition (0-3 semitones, pitch instability like excited speech), -a random level scatter; both time-variable, so a brk can make the stutter progressively wilder. -p permutes (every element used before reuse) for even coverage. Same seed = same take, guaranteed.

slicedata.description: REQUIRED text datafile of times (seconds, ascending) at which to slice the source into elements (write_data_file(); peakfind output format-compatible). Real floor rule: times must sit >= 2 splice-durations (0.006 s) from the start and step by the same ('Invalid time (0.001000) (closer to start than 2 splicedurs = 0.006) at line 1...'; 'Times (0.630000 & 0.620000) not increasing by 2 splicedurs (0.006)...') - the banner's 'MT = 0.016 secs' is NOT the enforced value (0.01 steps accepted, verified). LANDMINE: a time BEYOND the file end is accepted SILENTLY and changes the render (verified 2.6 on a 2.5 s file -> 5.84 s output at dur 4).

dur.description: Output duration target - the render fills to dur then finishes the segment in flight (overshoot up to ~one segment + silmax, seed-dependent; +0.35 s worst observed). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

segjoins.description: 1 = cut only within single elements; N = also use runs of 2..N joined elements as cut sources (cuts end in the last joined element). CDP-enforced '(1.000000 to 8.000000)' (Parameter[3]). Breakpoint refused (parameter 2).

silprop.description: Proportion of joins that get inserted silence (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 1.000000)', Parameter[4]; apart from none, minimum is 1 in 20 per banner). Breakpoint refused (parameter 3).

silmin.description: Minimum inserted-silence duration (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 10.000000)', Parameter[5]). silmin > silmax is accepted SILENTLY (runs; no swap message) - keep them ordered yourself. Breakpoint refused (parameter 4).

silmax.description: Maximum inserted-silence duration (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 10.000000)', Parameter[6]). Breakpoint refused (parameter 5).

seed.description: REQUIRED positional seed (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 256.000000)', Parameter[7]). WORKING and clock-free: same seed byte-identical (1.2 s apart), different seeds differ in content AND overshoot; seed 0 == seed 1 (glibc srand(0)==srand(1), verified byte-identical) - distinct-seed space 1-256. Entry default 1. Breakpoint refused (parameter 6).

trans.description: Range of random per-segment transposition (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 3.000000)', Parameter[8] - the banner gives NO bound; 3 st is the real cap). -t0 verified byte-equal to flag-less. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified at seed 5: 0->3 ramp differs from both -t0 and -t3 renders); transposed segments change length, so trans alters the overshoot too.

atten.description: Range of random per-segment attenuation (CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 1.000000)', Parameter[9]). -a0 verified byte-equal to flag-less. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0->1 ramp differs from both endpoint renders at seed 5).

bias.description: Bias of cut-segment sizes: negative favors shorter cuts, positive longer (CDP-enforced '(-1.000000 to 1.000000)', Parameter[10]). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 10').

mindur.description: Minimum cut-segment duration in ms (CDP-enforced '(8.000000 to 250.000000)', Parameter[11]). Breakpoint refused (refusal also quotes 'parameter 10' - CDP numbering quirk).

permute.description: Permute elements: all elements used before any repeats (default: elements picked entirely at random). Verified live (render and overshoot change).

examples.description: Re-babble a 2.5 s phrase into 8 seconds of speech-like stutter.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('words.txt', '0.62 1.22 1.92') - the inter-word boundaries. Output ~8.0-8.4 s; rerun with seed 5 for the identical take.

examples.description: Progressively wilder: pitch scatter ramps in over the output.
examples.expected_use: Steady start disintegrating into transposed fragments; -p guarantees every word appears before any repeats.

known_issues: Duration overshoots dur by up to ~one segment + silmax (seed-dependent; +0.35 s worst observed at dur 2.5) - the set_by pre-flight under-predicts by that much; keep dur below the cap with margin.
Slice times BEYOND the input's end are accepted SILENTLY and materially change the render (landmine, verified). silmin > silmax also accepted silently. Validate the datafile yourself.
The banner's 'Minimum timestep (MT) = 0.016 secs' is wrong: the enforced rule is 2 splice-durations = 0.006 s (both refusal messages quote 0.006, and a 0.01 step runs) - DIVERGENCE.

Seed 0 equals seed 1 (glibc; verified byte-identical) - no clock path anywhere; use seed VALUES for variants. trans/atten randomness rides the same seed, so brk-ramped -t/-a at a fixed seed is fully reproducible.
trans hard cap is 3 semitones (banner silent); refusals for -b and -m both quote 'parameter 10' (CDP numbering quirk, recorded).
Stereo accepted (2-ch output, same duration behavior); phase_sensitive true - on engine stereo splits use linked seeds for imaging, different seeds for decorrelated width.
